name: Golden Destinations Group Berhad
overview: Golden Destinations Group Berhad 于2026年4月在ACE Market上市，首次公开募股发行2亿股新股。年内，公司通过ICE Holidays Sdn Bhd签订协议，拟收购Menara Liberty的2个商业单位和9个办公单位，作为Proposed Acquisition 1及Proposed Acquisition 2的一部分。公司业务线未披露具体运营变化，最新季度营收为1.13亿令吉。
overview_en: Golden Destinations Group Berhad listed on the ACE Market in April 2026, with an initial public offering of 200 million new shares. During the year, the company, through ICE Holidays Sdn Bhd, entered into agreements to acquire 2 commercial parcels and 9 office parcels within Menara Liberty as part of Proposed Acquisition 1 and Proposed Acquisition 2. No specific operational changes were disclosed for its business lines, and the latest quarterly revenue was MYR 113.165 million.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司于2026年完成IPO并在ACE Market上市，同时推进两项拟议收购。
segments.note_en: The company completed its IPO and listed on the ACE Market in 2026, while progressing two proposed acquisitions.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE FOLLOWING:- (I) PROPOSED ACQUISITION 1; AND (II) PROPOSED ACQUISITION 2, (COLLECTIVELY REFERRED
actions.text: 公司向股东发出通函，内容涉及Proposed Acquisition 1及Proposed Acquisition 2。
actions.text_en: The company issued a circular to shareholders in relation to Proposed Acquisition 1 and Proposed Acquisition 2.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: ICE Holidays Sdn Bhd与Liberty General Insurance Berhad签订有条件买卖协议，拟收购Menara Liberty内的2个商业单位和9个办公单位，总面积为11,794平方米。
actions.text_en: ICE Holidays Sdn Bhd entered into a conditional sale and purchase agreement with Liberty General Insurance Berhad to acquire 2 commercial parcels and 9 office parcels within Menara Liberty, with a total parcel area of 11,794 square metres.

actions.title: INITIAL PUBLIC OFFERING IN CONJUNCTION WITH THE LISTING OF AND QUOTATION FOR THE ENTIRE ENLARGED ISSUED ORDINARY SHARE CAPITAL OF GOLDEN DES
actions.text: 公司进行首次公开募股，发行2亿股新股，并在马来西亚交易所ACE Market上市。
actions.text_en: The company undertook an initial public offering of 200 million new shares and listed on the ACE Market of Bursa Malaysia Securities Berhad.
